title: 3 Questions a Godly Man Asks Before He Posts
caption:
3 questions a godly man asks before he posts.

Who is this really for? Would I say this with him in the room? Does it point past me?

Proverbs 27:2: let another praise you, and not your own mouth. Run the three questions before you hit send, and see how many drafts survive.

What is one post sitting in your drafts right now?
